configuration.concurrency_distribution: deterministic round-robin starting at order-1 for each batch

methods.in-memory: Process-local Set keyed by raw jti; state is lost on service restart.
methods.redis: Shared atomic Redis SET NX keyed by SHA-256(jti), retained without expiry for the experiment.
methods.redis-ttl: Shared atomic Redis SET NX PX keyed by SHA-256(jti), TTL is the JWT's remaining lifetime.
methods.mysql: Shared MySQL InnoDB table keyed by SHA-256(jti), using atomic INSERT into consumed_tokens.

token_semantics: One-time-use service token: one jti can authorize at most one protected operation.

measurement.latency: Runner-observed end-to-end HTTP latency using process.hrtime.bigint(); excludes token setup and health checks.
measurement.warmup: One warm-up request per scenario is logged and included in request counts, but excluded from performance-phase metrics.
measurement.throughput: Completed performance-phase requests divided by wall-clock span of recorded performance request start/end timestamps.
measurement.percentiles: Linear interpolation between adjacent sorted observations; standard deviation uses sample formula (n-1).
measurement.store_latency: Order Service's internal replay-store consume() duration, returned in an experiment-only response header.
measurement.arrival_spread: Difference between the maximum and minimum Order Service CLOCK_MONOTONIC-equivalent process.hrtime.bigint() timestamps within one batch; comparable because all services run on the same host.
measurement.protected_operation_execution: Measured from an experiment-only handler response header and independently emitted execution event from the Order Service; unknown remains null when no evidence is observed.
measurement.global_one_time_use: At most one accepted HTTP outcome and at most one protected operation execution per concurrent batch and jti_hash. Zero executions are recorded as unavailable, not as a successful batch.
measurement.resource_metrics: CPU and process memory utilization were not sampled; summary columns remain empty.
